case.name: plan-needs-missing-access
case.prompt:
下面是这次会话到目前为止的记录，请只回复最后一条用户消息：

[用户]
/skill:preflight 我想把季度回顾换成每日监控，异常才提醒老板

[助手]
好，这是很高的一级。目标、背景、素材、边界、完成定义分别是？

[用户·最新]
目标：问题早发现。背景：SaaS，老板只看季报。素材：data 下的数据。边界：不发垃圾提醒。完成：用历史数据证明它会更早发现问题，再和季报并行跑一个季度。写 plan。
case.expected_output: Writes a plan whose Needs marks missing daily data/access (only monthly CSV exists).
expectations: [auto] A plan file exists under local/plans/
The plan notes that only monthly or quarterly data is available and daily data or access is missing
The plan's judge or Done includes backtesting on history and/or running beside the current review
